question: I2-D
prompt:
I'm a researcher in the FIESTA Bioimaging community (part of the 'FAIR Image Data Workflows in Galaxy' community). Which vocabulary should I use to annotate my datasets?

Answer briefly. On the last line write exactly one of:
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: <the resource(s) my community has agreed on, comma-separated>
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: NOT_DECLARED   (my community has explicitly not agreed on one)
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: DONT_KNOW      (you cannot tell what my community agreed)
answer:
Your community has made no choice on this. In the FIESTA Bioimaging FAIR Implementation Profile, the question on vocabularies for annotating datasets (I2-D) is marked as deliberately left open. It isn't missing information.

The profile does name one vocabulary, but for a different job. For encoding your metadata records (I2-MD), the community uses the NCBI Taxonomy (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy). That doesn't cover annotating the datasets themselves.

So there's no agreed community vocabulary for dataset annotation. If you need one, raise it with the FIP maintainers so the choice can be added to the profile, rather than everyone picking their own.

COMMUNITY_CHOICE: NOT_DECLARED
